title: Burls
body:
Burls are a unique sub-resource to trees[1]. Unlike trees, however, burls are unique in that their wood cannot be turned into refined planks, but are instead highly valued by players for their unique sanded/plank texture. Burls also cannot be chopped into smaller pieces.

Burls can rarely spawn on the largest of specific living trees identified by the fact they also spawn dead variants such as stumps and fallen logs.

As of writing the examples currently include: Oak, Petrified Oak, Birch, Red Birch, Pine, Blue Pine, Red Maple, Olive, Willow, Sakura, Acacia, Sequoia, and Spruce.

And now Shadow since the introduction of the secret update.

One unique case among burls is the Beehive, which is considered a woodburl material by the game but can grow on multiple species of tree leaves and may also be put through the Press Machine after being planked in order to make a jar of Honey.


All tree Burl types:

  • Oak Burl
  • Petrified Oak Burl
  • Birch Burl
  • Red Birch Burl
  • Pine Burl
  • Blue Pine Burl
  • Red Maple Burl
  • Olive Burl
  • Willow Burl
  • Sakura Burl
  • Acacia Burl
  • Sequoia Burl
  • Spruce Burl
  • Shadow tree burl

There's rumors of a burl for the Suiratcal and Heavenly Tree however they are likely so rare that they are just rumors. This cannot be correct. Burls only spawn on trees that also spawn a dead version such as stumps and fallen logs - unlike Suiratcal and Heavenly.
